relocation_line: I will relocate to the Sunshine Coast for this role and can start three weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I'd like to start in construction materials testing. Your Bli Bli lab tests asphalt and aggregates for infrastructure work across Queensland, and that's the kind of laboratory role I want to get into.

In the diploma I studied the AS 1289 soil testing standards and kept technical records as part of the civil design work. On site in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and wrote up the results. I have a Victorian driver's licence and a White Card.

I'd move to the Sunshine Coast and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
notes: Full-time construction materials testing (asphalt and aggregates) at Bli Bli. Previous lab experience is listed but no year minimum; Certificate IV is preferred only. SEEK apply links out. Fit 75 (50 + 15 duty + 10 lane 2).
